Summary: Project setup & authentication
Description: Repository, branching strategy, sign-up/login with JWT and role-based access control.

Summary: Set up Git repository, branching strategy and project scaffolding
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- main and develop branches protected
- feature/<KEY>-short-name branch convention documented
- backend and frontend skeletons run locally

Summary: As an employee I can sign up for an account
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Public sign-up always creates EMPLOYEE role even if ADMIN is sent
- Duplicate e-mail returns 409
- Password is stored as bcrypt hash

Summary: As a user I can log in and stay logged in (JWT)
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Valid credentials return a signed JWT
- Wrong password returns 401
- Deactivated users cannot log in

Summary: Role-based access control for ADMIN and EMPLOYEE
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Admin-only endpoints return 403 for employees
- Frontend hides admin menus for employees
- Missing token returns 401

Summary: As a user I can update my profile and change my password
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Name, department and phone are editable
- Password change requires the current password

Summary: Resource catalogue
Description: Admins maintain the inventory of laptops, monitors, printers, rooms and projectors.

Summary: As an admin I can add, edit and delete resources
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Asset tag is unique
- Cannot delete an allocated resource or one with upcoming bookings
- Every change is written to the audit log

Summary: As a user I can search and filter the resource catalogue
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Search by name, tag or location
- Filter by category and status

Summary: As an admin I can change a resource status (retire, maintenance)
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- ALLOCATED can only be set by the allocation workflow
- Allocated resources cannot be retired

Summary: Requests & allocation
Description: Employees request assets, admins approve them and assets are allocated and returned.

Summary: As an employee I can request an available asset
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Only AVAILABLE, non-shared assets can be requested
- Duplicate pending request returns 409
- Admins are notified

Summary: As an admin I can approve or reject requests
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Approval allocates the asset
- Rejection requires a reason
- Competing pending requests are auto-closed

Summary: Prevent the same asset being allocated twice (atomic allocation)
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- AVAILABLE -> ALLOCATED is a single conditional update
- Second allocation attempt returns 409

Summary: Return workflow with condition inspection
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Employee requests return
- Admin checks the asset in as GOOD or DAMAGED
- DAMAGED opens a HIGH priority maintenance ticket

Summary: As an admin I can allocate an asset directly to an employee
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Optional due date
- Overdue allocations are highlighted

Summary: Shared resource booking
Description: Conference rooms and projectors are booked by time slot without overlaps.

Summary: As a user I can book a room or projector for a time slot
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- End must be after start
- No bookings in the past
- Attendees cannot exceed room capacity

Summary: Reject overlapping bookings with 409 Conflict
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Overlap rule: newStart < existingEnd AND newEnd > existingStart
- Back-to-back slots are allowed
- Conflict metric is exported to Prometheus

Summary: Day-view booking calendar
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Rooms x hours grid
- Click an empty slot to book
- Own bookings are highlighted

Summary: Cancel a booking (owner or admin)
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Other employees get 403
- Cancelled slot becomes bookable again

Summary: Maintenance, notifications & audit
Description: Fault reporting, repair tracking, in-app notifications and a full audit trail.

Summary: As a user I can report a faulty resource
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Resource becomes UNDER_MAINTENANCE
- Only one open ticket per resource
- Employees can only report shared resources or their own assets

Summary: As an admin I can progress and resolve maintenance tickets
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- OPEN -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED
- Resolving restores the resource status
- Reporter is notified

Summary: Audit log of every state-changing action
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Who, what, when for every action
- Admin-only, paginated, filterable by entity

Summary: In-app notifications
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Bell with unread badge
- Mark all as read

Summary: Dashboards
Description: Role-specific dashboards with live statistics and charts.

Summary: Admin dashboard with KPIs and charts
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Resources by status and category
- Bookings per day
- Open tickets and recent activity

Summary: Employee dashboard
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- My assets, requests, bookings and open issues

Summary: DevOps: containers, CI/CD & monitoring
Description: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana and Jira automation (no Kubernetes).

Summary: Dockerize backend and frontend with multi-stage builds
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Backend runs as non-root with HEALTHCHECK
- Frontend served by nginx which proxies /api

Summary: Docker Compose stack for the whole system
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- One command starts MongoDB, API, frontend, Prometheus, Grafana and exporters
- Services wait for healthy dependencies

Summary: GitHub Actions CI pipeline
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Backend tests against an ephemeral MongoDB
- Frontend build
- Docker images build
- Runs on every push and PR

Summary: Full-stack smoke test in CI with docker compose
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Stack boots in CI
- Prometheus target is UP
- Grafana dashboards are provisioned

Summary: CD: publish versioned images to GitHub Container Registry
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- main -> latest
- v* tags -> semver tags and GitHub Release

Summary: Instrument the API with Prometheus metrics
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Golden-signal HTTP metrics
- Business counters and gauges
- Bounded label cardinality

Summary: Provision Grafana dashboards as code
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Datasource and dashboards auto-provisioned
- Application and infrastructure dashboards

Summary: Prometheus alert rules
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- API down, DB down, 5xx rate, p95 latency, critical tickets

Summary: Jira <-> GitHub integration
Description:
Acceptance criteria:
- Commits and PRs referencing an issue key comment on it
- Merged PR moves the issue to Done
- CI failure on main raises a Bug
